commentary.bulkers: Carras have committed their Capesize" Aquabella" 177/2005 Namura & Sasebo, Japan (SS 11/2024, DD 08/2023, BWTS fitted) to Chinese buyers for high USD 19 mill. Alios Bulkers sold their Panamax "Bellamys" 76/2005 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 01/2025, DD 01/2023, BWTS fitted) to Chinese buyers for USD 17 mill. Note that a week ago, the "Great Talent" 76/2005 Sasebo, Japan (SS 01/2025, DD 02/2023, BWTS fitted) was sold at the same price. On the Supramax sector, ORIX Corp sold their sister vessels "Million Bell" & "Glad Mark" 58/2012 Kawasaki, Japan (SS/DD 10/2022 & SS/DD 07/2022 accordingly) for USD 44 mill enbloc basis delivery Q1 2022, whilst the "Trans Oceanic" 58/2012 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 07/2026, DD 05/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold a week ago at USD 23 mill. Moreover, Fujian Yongjia Shipping committed their "Gutian Loyal" 52/2004 Oshima, Japan (SS 11/2024, DD 07/2022, BWTS fitted) for USD 13,8 mill. Remind you that a couple of weeks ago, the two-years-younger "Bao Ella" 53/2006 Imabari, Japan (SS 05/2026, DD 08/2024, BWTS fitted) was sold at region USD 15 mill. The Handysize "Ocean Opal" 37/2012 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS/DD 07/2022) was committed to undisclosed buyers for USD 18,4 mill. For reference, the Japanese built "Nicoline Bulker" 38/2012 Naikai, Japan (SS/DD 01/2022) was sold a month ago at USD 20 mill. Furthermore, Yamamoto Kisen committed their "Cactus K" 31/2011 Hakodate, Japan (SS 06/2026, DD 06/2024) to Greek buyers for USD 16,8 mill. Note that the OHBS "Maritime Faith" 33/2011 Kanda, Japan (SS 02/2026, DD 11/2023, BWTS fitted) was sold a week ago at high USD 16 mill. In addition, following their sale of the "Niki C" 30/2011 New Century, China (SS/DD 09/2021) at USD 12 mill, Messrs Cosmoship sold their "Serenity C" 31/2011 Fujian, China (SS/DD 09/2021) to Norwegian buyers Vega Bulk Carriers for USD 13,5 mill basis SS/DD passed & BWTS fitted.
commentary.tankers: AET Tankers have sold their Aframax sister vessels "Bunga Kelana 7" & "Bunga Kelana 8" 105/2004 Samsung, Korea (SS 01/2024, DD 02/2022 & SS 03/2024, DD 03/2022 respectively) for USD 13,3 mill each. For comparison, the two-years-younger "Sunny Atlantica" 114/2006 Samsung, Korea (SS/DD 11/2021) was sold a week ago at USD 15,5 mill. Greek buyers IMS have acquired the MR2 "Angel No. 5" 46/2009 Jinling, China (SS 05/2024, DD 05/2022) from Zheng Yu Shipping for high USD 11 mill, while Epic Gas sold their Japanese built "Justice Express" 46/2011 Shin Kurushima, Japan (SS 03/2026, DD 01/2024, BWTS fitted) to Greek buyers for USD 17 mill.
